claim: GOLFWIN.EXE v1.014 uses a 44-byte ball structure with X/Y, vertical force, horizontal force, direction, height, distance-to-hole and pause at recovered offsets 0x00 through 0x1C.

sources.observation: Embedded debug descriptors point to the live ball fields; update code repeatedly indexes the structure with a 0x2C stride.

notes: Terrain-tail fields after +0x1C are only partially named.
